html:
SMTO-MEM-0037 — The file changed after it was added

GUID: a74dcd7a-e62e-5dd4-a1c5-ef2df6032ad4
Slug: knowledge-source-changed
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • SMTO checks that a file is exactly the same as when it was added. This file's contents are different now, so SMTO won't use it, to avoid giving answers from the wrong version.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Knowledge, find the document, open Manage on its card and select Replace. Choose the current version of the file from your computer. Replacing stores a fresh copy and processes it again, so it matches what you see.
  2. If the file was attached to a conversation, attach it again in that conversation, then ask the Agent to add it to Knowledge. The attachment changed after it was attached, so SMTO needs the new copy.
  3. Wait until the document shows Ready to search. Searches use the document only after it has been processed again.

What success looks like

  • The document shows Ready to search and Preview shows its current content.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; files changing on their own can mean something else is editing SMTO's storage folder. Don't edit or move files inside SMTO's data folder yourself.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The stored copy of a Knowledge source no longer matches the size or SHA-256 recorded when it was saved (RagStore.read_asset), or an attached conversation file changed after it was attached (RagService.import_context).

What this means

  • The file content no longer matches the version captured for this source. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported source_changed. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The source is read consistently and indexing completes.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Re-upload or Replace the document so a new asset and hash are recorded; for conversation attachments, attach the file again before importing. Investigate what modified files in the rag-files directory or the saved context store, because SMTO never edits stored assets in place.
  • Choose the current version of the file and upload or replace it again.

Retry and execution caution

  • The source is read consistently and indexing completes.

How to verify the fix

  • The source is read consistently and indexing completes.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
